expected_runtime_workers3: config 1: about 13-18 min (D-07 reference: ext_gate_auto3, same grid plus the extra method tolerant_auto3_nogate, 1027.6 s under load ~42 on 12 cores; ext_auto5_main 1405.6 s with 5 methods); config 2: about 7-11 min (ext_auto5_a1 with 4 scenarios: 1050.8 s; config 2 has 2 scenarios plus the D-07H calibration phase); analyzer < 10 s; total about 20-30 min
confirmatory_rule: CONFIRMED iff all four hold and integrity checks I1-I5 pass (and the preflight printed PREFLIGHT OK). Pooled coverage counts failed or absent runs as covering no non-null pair (their n_nonnull stays in the denominator); a ruled cell fails if tolerant_auto3 has more than 3 failed/absent runs of 60 or no ok run. C1: coverage of tolerant_auto3 >= 0.90 in missing and reversed x {0.2, 0.5} at T = 80 and 150 (config 1, 8 cells). C2: in the none cell, IS(tolerant_auto3) <= 1.35 x IS(tolerant_v4) at T = 40, 80 and 150, means over units where both are ok, at least 57 such units (config 1). C3: in the GES cell at T = 80 and 150, coverage >= 0.90 and IS(tolerant_auto3) <= 1.10 x IS(tolerant_v4) on the same paired basis (config 1). L1: scenario latent1, coverage >= 0.90 in missing-0.2 and reversed-0.2 at T = 80 and 150 (config 2). Reported, not ruled: one-sided cluster-bootstrap p for H0 'coverage <= 0.90' (2000 resamples of topologies, seed 0) and Holm (alpha 0.05) over the 14 coverage cells; n_ok/n_exp of every method in every cell; ok-only coverage and unpaired IS ratios. Mandatory sentence with any report: on the D-07 dry run C1 at T80 reversed-0.5 was 0.903, the only cell of 14 that Holm did not reject (13/14); topology bootstrap of the D-07 rows gives P(CONFIRMED) as in results/ext_auto3fix_fragility/fragility.json.
if_not_confirmed: claim C-auto stays exploratory (D-07 development only); the paper presents the declared mode as primary.
e1_note: Built-in and ext seeds depend on the cell position c_idx (E1, not fixed before P4-H2 by user decision). Config 1 has the cell order of ext_v51_p4h2 for its first 7 cells (GES last), so its tolerant_v4 rows should equal those of P1; config 2 has different c_idx and different k_idx for missing/reversed, so its damaged skeletons and every method's draws differ from config 1. Tests pair only within a config. See doc section 4.
